## Exhibition "Fossils as Reflections of the Past" opened in Aleksinac

The exhibition's authors are Dr Biljana Mitrović, Sanja Alaburić and Branko Radulović, who through this display sought to bring the richness of palaeontological heritage and the importance of its scientific study closer to the wider public. In addition to original exhibits, the exhibition also offers a broader scientific context, highlighting the development of life on Earth, climate and ecosystem changes throughout the geological past, as well as the importance of researchers who have contributed to discovering and preserving this valuable heritage.

The opening was attended by numerous visitors, lovers of nature and culture, as well as representatives of the local community, who had the opportunity to become acquainted with the exhibition and its scientific and educational significance.

We invite all interested visitors to come to the exhibition and discover the stories that fossils preserve – stories of life, change, and worlds that preceded our own.
